headline:
تحديث FORSAKEN يصل
إلى No Man's Sky
label: تحديث
note: No Man's Sky FORSAKEN update (Hello Games Steam announcement 14:05Z, read in full): haunted tech and biological horrors to salvage, biomechanical corvette modules, postal missions, radial weapon menu, minimal HUD, seamless warping; iPhone and iPad release today. Official FORSAKEN trailer from Steam with its own music. Narrated trailer: lines are the faithful Arabic subtitle of the narrator, one continuous stretch 11.4 to 42.9 s; trailer's own 0.17 s white transition flash at 33.4 s kept.
speech_ok: narrator states the update's features; the story lines are its faithful Arabic subtitle, timed to the sentences; headline over the first sentence
